settings.standardization: per session: mean and population SD over all development trials of that session (EP04 training_statistics with no held-out fold)
settings.voxel_rule: in fixed ROI mask, finite on every development presentation, positive SD in every session; >=3 voxels per ROI
settings.repeat_rule: image eligible with >=2 valid primary presentations (finite on all retained primary-sector voxels); EVC also needs >=2 valid EVC presentations
settings.spectral_geometry: per participant x category on eligible images: SVD of column-centred L2 rows; squared Euclidean on U_a * s_b (rank order)
settings.c3_transform: per participant: PCA of all 4,712 development embeddings (L2 rows, centred), leading 256 axes; Phi=(X-mu) V diag(s^(alpha-1)), alpha = median of the participant's five D2 R1 alpha-hat values per model
settings.rsa: Spearman (average ranks) of upper triangles, Fisher z; equal weights over categories and primary sectors, then participants
settings.c1: CLIP-DINOv2 native gap: spectral if mean <= -margin and >=4/5 participants <= -margin; selection_only if mean > -margin and >=4/5 participants > -margin; else indeterminate. PEcore classified the same way (secondary). Leave-one-category-out means reported.
settings.c2a: Within-category: for CLIP and SigLIP2, E_val < 0 for the mean and >=4/5 participants (E_val = 0.5[(RSA(m|m)-RSA(m|ref)) + (RSA(ref|m)-RSA(ref|ref))], rows = eigenvectors|eigenvalues).
settings.c2b: All pairs among each participant's eligible confirmatory images: for CLIP and SigLIP2, evaluable if the mean native all-pairs gap <= -margin; pass if |all-pairs gap with DINOv2 eigenvalues on VLM eigenvectors| <= 0.5 |native all-pairs gap| for the mean and for >=4/5 participants (each with a negative native gap).
settings.c2b_retention: C2b is confirmatory only if the lock records that the pre-lock dev-test met the same C2b rule for both CLIP and SigLIP2; otherwise C2b is descriptive.
settings.c2_pecore_secondary: Within-category PEcore: E_val < 0 and E_vec > 0 for the mean and >=4/5 participants.
settings.c3: For each VLM: mean (C3 transform minus native) > 0 and >=4/5 participants > 0.
settings.gate: DINOv2 native confirmatory aggregate > 95th percentile ('higher') of 10,000 within-category whole-image permutations of the model RDM, each permutation shared across participants and sectors; failure makes the opening uninformative.
settings.embeddings: provider 2026-09-28 corrected HDF5 files in inputs/laion_ood_embeddings_corrected (ETags in download_record.json)
